in_hindi.name: Gunavathi
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Goodness
in_hindi.long_meaning: Gunavathi एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Gunavathi is a Sanskrit name for the goddess of goodness and virtue. It is derived from the words 'gu' meaning 'good' and 'vathi' meaning 'she who holds'. The name symbolizes the embodiment of virtues such as wisdom, compassion, and strength.
